main-ui.description: The Neelima main UI webview. Granted only the commands it actually calls, plus the core event API. No fs/shell plugins exist in this app at all.

provider-bridge.description: Provider webviews (the embedded AI chat pages the user logs into). The ONLY command reachable from these pages is lb_bridge - a small, typed, size-capped intake channel for the adapter runtime. Every other app command is denied here by the app ACL manifest. Remote scope is a wildcard because adapter domains are user-configurable at runtime (capabilities are compile-time); the one-command allowlist is the security boundary, see docs/THREAT-MODEL.md.
